## 

```{r}
install.packages('text2vec')
```

```{r}
library('text2vec')
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Train word embeddings on SAA abstract corpus using text2vec
# Output: wv matrix ready for CMDist()
# =========================================================

library(text2vec)
library(tidyverse)  # dplyr/tidyr used to reshape all_tokens below
# `all_tokens` and `dtm_full` should already exist in your environment
# from load-clean-data.qmd

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Reuse the SAME tokens already used to build dtm_full
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# `all_tokens` comes from load-clean-data.qmd (doc_id, year, word),
# already lowercased, stopword-filtered, and digit-filtered via
# unnest_tokens() + anti_join(stop_words) + anti_join(custom_stops).
# Reusing it (instead of re-cleaning raw text) guarantees wv and
# dtm_full share an identical vocabulary -> no "ceramics" vs "ceramic"
# or missing-word surprises when you run CMDist() later.

doc_tokens <- all_tokens %>%
  group_by(doc_id) %>%
  summarise(tokens = list(word), .groups = "drop")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build itoken + vocabulary from these token lists
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# NOTE: because stopwords were already removed, skip-gram windows
# will jump over the gaps left behind (effectively a slightly wider
# "semantic" window than the raw text had). This is a common and
# acceptable tradeoff for an initial test, but be aware it's a
# deviation from training on fully raw, unfiltered text.

it <- itoken(
  doc_tokens$tokens,
  ids = doc_tokens$doc_id,
  progressbar = TRUE
)

vocab <- create_vocabulary(it)

# Prune vocabulary: drop very rare words (noisy vectors) and
# optionally very common ones (stopwords already help, but you
# can also trim top terms if needed)
vocab <- prune_vocabulary(
  vocab,
  term_count_min = 5,     # adjust to 10 if vocab is still very large
  doc_proportion_max = 0.5
)

cat("Vocabulary size after pruning:", nrow(vocab), "\n")

# Quick overlap check against dtm_full -- confirms the two share a
# common vocabulary before you invest time in training
overlap <- intersect(vocab$term, colnames(dtm_full))
cat("Vocab terms also in dtm_full:", length(overlap),
    "of", nrow(vocab), "\n")

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create term-co-occurrence matrix (TCM)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
vectorizer <- vocab_vectorizer(vocab)

tcm <- create_tcm(
  it,
  vectorizer,
  skip_grams_window = 5   # context window size
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Train GloVe model
# ---------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)

glove <- GlobalVectors$new(
  rank = 100,     # embedding dimensionality (100d is reasonable for ~10M tokens)
  x_max = 10
)

wv_main <- glove$fit_transform(
  tcm,
  n_iter = 20,
  convergence_tol = 0.01,
  n_threads = parallel::detectCores() - 1
)

wv_context <- glove$components

# GloVe recommends summing main + context vectors for final representation
wv <- wv_main + t(wv_context)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Inspect: sanity-check nearest neighbors
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cos_sim <- function(word, wv, n = 10) {
  if (!(word %in% rownames(wv))) {
    stop("Word not in vocabulary: ", word)
  }
  v <- wv[word, , drop = FALSE]
  sims <- sim2(x = wv, y = v, method = "cosine", norm = "l2")
  sort(sims[, 1], decreasing = TRUE)[1:n]
}

# Example checks (swap in terms relevant to your corpus)
cos_sim("ceramic", wv)
cos_sim("identity", wv)
cos_sim("colonial", wv)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Save for use with CMDist()
# ---------------------------------------------------------
saveRDS(wv, "saa_wv_100d.rds")

# Later, in your CMDist script:
# wv <- readRDS("saa_wv_100d.rds")
# library(text2map)
# cmd_out <- CMDist(dtm = dtm_full, cw = c("concept_word"), wv = wv, missing = "remove")

```
